title: Bad Bunny Debuts at Paris La Défense Arena — Europe's Largest Indoor Venue
detail: Three days after opening the French leg in Marseille, Bad Bunny plays two sold-out nights at Paris La Défense Arena (July 4–5, 2026) — his first-ever show at the Île-de-France venue, Europe's largest indoor arena, and his first Paris date on the tour. The over-two-and-a-half-hour sets blend reggaetón, salsa, and plena in a tribute to his Puerto Rican roots. 'Vou 787' and 'Como un Bebe' are the exclusive songs across the two nights; Chuwi again opens.
